sources.title: gemma-4-12B-it-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-4-12B-it-GGUF is a set of llama.cpp imatrix GGUF quantizations of Google's Gemma 4 12B instruction-tuned model, published by bartowski. It targets local text-to-text inference and carries an Apache 2.0 license. The most important decision is not whether to use the model, but which quantization fits your memory budget: files range from 4.71GB to 23.83GB, with Q4_K_M at 7.66GB ...
